description: Motion-library tier catalogue. `source` is the current authoring location; `tier` is the target three-tier classification, not a claim that the file has moved. `exists` describes asset coverage, not gameplay wiring.

tier_rule.base: One simple body or appendage motion.
tier_rule.composite: A sequence or blend of base motions; base_motions names the ingredients, including planned gap IDs.
tier_rule.special: Custom implementation is intrinsic because of contacts, props, anatomy, support geometry, or multiple actors.

caller_rule: Callers are actual Java behavior/action IDs, direct playAction calls, renderer clip selections or direct track sampling, and moments.json row IDs. Metadata-only reads and enum declarations are not callers; `no caller` means no such Java or moments caller was found. Generic /yukkuri action command availability is not counted.
